summary_markdown: The conversation covered technical questions regarding antenna performance. Specifically, a theoretical question was raised about whether 'fin' antennas in Denmark might perform worse detecting modern smartphones compared to SISO antennas. Participants recalled previous comparisons of various antennas (panorama, SISO, AFA, and another brand). It was noted that the consensus from those tests favored SISO as the most reliable option.
decisions: SISO antenna was deemed the most reliable option based on past testing.
